parameters.query: SELECT id, platform, apartment_id, ical_url FROM avail_source WHERE enabled AND kind = 'ical' ORDER BY id
SELECT s.id, s.apartment_id, s.avito_item_id, v.value AS account_id FROM avail_source s JOIN system_vars v ON v.key = 'avito_account_id' WHERE s.enabled AND s.kind = 'avito_api' ORDER BY s.id

SELECT s.avito_item_id, s.apartment_id, v.value AS account_id, p->'body' AS body, p->>'hash' AS hash FROM avail_source s JOIN system_vars v ON v.key = 'avito_account_id' CROSS JOIN LATERAL avito_push_payload(s.avito_item_id) p LEFT JOIN avito_push_state st ON st.avito_item_id = s.avito_item_id WHERE s.enabled AND s.kind = 'avito_api' AND (SELECT value FROM system_vars WHERE key = 'avito_push_enabled') = 'true' AND (st.last_hash IS DISTINCT FROM p->>'hash' OR st.last_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'ok')
